# Apogee

[![Apogee — Space Ponyos character portrait](https://spaceponyos.com/assets/characters/apogee.jpg)](https://spaceponyos.com/characters)

Apogee is Shino (ShinodaGE)'s cheerful, freckled teenage pegasus from *Space Ponyos*. She dreams of becoming an astronaut, but her more immediate wish is to reconnect with her estranged mother, Delta Vee. Her father, Jet Stream, runs a commercial spaceflight company, and her best friend is Daisy Cutter.

- **Appearance:** Pale yellow coat, brown freckles, short swept blue-and-turquoise mane, pink-red eyes and small wings.
- **Name and origins:** Apogee is her creator-given name, documented in Shino's [2017 character backstory](https://deltaveesjunkyard.tumblr.com/post/161559740870/shinonsfw-ive-been-working-on-deltas-story), which identifies her as a 16-year-old high-school student living with her father in Las Pegasus. Her name refers to the farthest point from Earth in an orbit, fitting the family's aerospace theme. The exact first use of the name was not established.
- **Continuity and appearances:** A central character in the independent *Delta Vee's Junkyard* webcomic and its revised *Space Ponyos* comic books ([creator's project history](https://www.patreon.com/SpacePonyos/about)). She belongs to that fan-created continuity, not the Hasbro television series.
- **Speaking status:** Speaking character; Lizzie Freeman is credited as Apogee in PrinceWhateverer's 2020 [comic dub, Episode 1](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=LlM3JoPRzA8). No official television voice credit applies.
- **More artwork:** Shino's [Pocket Ponyos](https://www.deviantart.com/shinodage/art/Pocket-Ponyos-777353009), published December 19, 2018, depicts Apogee with her space-themed family.

## Important moments

- **Trying to lift her mother's spirits — [Delta Vee's Junkyard, Episode 4](https://www.equestriadaily.com/2020/09/delta-vees-junkyard-episode-4.html).** Apogee tries to cheer up Delta, illustrating her determination to rebuild their relationship. Timestamp unavailable.
- **Reaching out despite rejection — [Picking Yourself Up, chapter 1: A Helping Hoof](https://www.fimfiction.net/story/434245/1/picking-yourself-up/a-helping-hoof).** In this separately authored alternate-universe fanfiction, Apogee tells Delta that she still wants her in her life and tries to help around her home. This is an adaptation example, not a verified original-comic scene; no video timestamp applies.

The original comic reader did not expose readable panels, and video playback could not be verified, so exact scene timestamps and a second original-comic moment remain unconfirmed. No GitHub or PR workflow was accessed.
